name: frames-benchmark-wikipedia
description:
FRAMES Wikipedia Articles
	

This dataset contains fulltext of Wikipeida articles used in FRAMES benchmark (https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.12941) for testing the capabilities of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems across factuality, retrieval accuracy, and reasoning.
The articles are retrieved in Oct. 2024.
evaluation_method: human_eval complemented by retrieval-accuracy and automated factuality metrics (e.g., retrieval precision/recall, exact/partial match on grounded answers)
general_score_metric: human evaluation score (supported by retrieval accuracy)
reputation: Introduced alongside the FRAMES paper for RAG evaluation; gaining attention in retrieval/factuality benchmarking but still relatively new.
